description: Changes a list that already exists, all of it in one call. list sets the list's own title, display unit, trip dates and trail (only the fields given; an empty string clears a date or the trail). folders renames, reorders, reclassifies or removes folders, named by id or current name; removing one removes its rows. add puts new rows on, into a folder by name (made when missing) or under a group by the parent row's id. update changes rows by the ids get_list gives: any field, null clearing one that can be cleared; a new folder, place or group; a catalog_id to link or relink the row where it sits, null to unlink. remove takes rows off by id, a group's nested rows with it. The parts apply in that order as one change, and nothing is applied unless every part is valid: a row or folder named that isn't there fails the whole call. A name or weight changed on a catalog-linked row is kept as the owner's own. Takes the list's edit link, or its share code under a signed-in account that has filed it.

add.description: New rows. Each may name its folder, or the group to join.

catalog_id.description: A catalog row id from search_catalog. The row takes the catalog's brand, name, variant, gear type and cited weight, and follows catalog corrections; a weight_g given as well is kept as your own figure.

classification.description: base, worn or consumable. Omit to follow the folder's default.

folder.description: The folder to put it in, by name. Created when the list has no folder of that name.

gear_type.description: What kind of thing it is: Tent, Quilt, Trail runners.

group.description: The id of a top-level row already on the list, from get_list, to nest this row under: it joins that group, in the group's folder. Not with folder or items.

items.description: Rows nested under this one, making it a group: stakes under a tent, snacks under a day. One level deep; a nested row is in its parent's folder.

catalog_id.description: A catalog row id from search_catalog. The row takes the catalog's brand, name, variant, gear type and cited weight, and follows catalog corrections; a weight_g given as well is kept as your own figure.

classification.description: base, worn or consumable. Omit to follow the folder's default.

gear_type.description: What kind of thing it is: Tent, Quilt, Trail runners.

name.description: The product or item name. Required.

needs_cooking.description: Food to cook on this trip. Each unit assumes one boil for a rough fuel estimate; no quantity or weight changes.

note.description: A short free-text note on the row.

variant.description: Size, length or configuration that changes the weight, such as Long or 20F.

volume_l.description: Water only (a name ending in water), in place of qty and weight_g: its whole volume in litres, 1 kg each.

weight_g.description: Weight of ONE unit, in grams. Omit when unknown; the list keeps working without it, and a row with a catalog_id takes the catalog's cited weight.

worn_qty.description: Of qty, how many are worn rather than carried (three pairs of socks, one on your feet). For a row that is entirely worn, set classification to worn instead.

name.description: The product or item name. Required.

needs_cooking.description: Food to cook on this trip. Each unit assumes one boil for a rough fuel estimate; no quantity or weight changes.

note.description: A short free-text note on the row.

variant.description: Size, length or configuration that changes the weight, such as Long or 20F.

volume_l.description: Water only (a name ending in water), in place of qty and weight_g: its whole volume in litres, 1 kg each.

worn_qty.description: Of qty, how many are worn rather than carried (three pairs of socks, one on your feet). For a row that is entirely worn, set classification to worn instead.

again.description: A call with rows to add that is identical to one made in the last ten minutes is taken as a retry and does nothing: the earlier result comes back with repeated set. Pass true to make the same change a second time on purpose.

edit_link.description: The list's edit link, whole (mahonia.app/e/CODE#token). The part after # is the write capability. Leave it out to name a list filed under the signed-in account by share_code instead.

classification.description: What rows in this folder count as unless they say otherwise.

folder.description: The folder's id from get_list, or its current name.

name.description: A new name, unique in the list.

position.description: Its place in the list's folder order, 0 for first.

remove.description: True to remove the folder and every row in it.

list.description: The list's own fields. Only the fields given change.

end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or an empty string to clear.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or an empty string to clear.

trail_distance_km.description: Stored in metres and shown in the list's own distance unit.

trail_url.description: An http(s) link, or an empty string to clear the trail and everything that came with it (label, distance, climb, route).

unit.description: The unit the list displays in. Weights are in grams regardless.

remove.description: Ids of rows to take off, from get_list.

share_code.description: Instead of the edit link: the share code or share link of a list filed under the connector's account, as get_list with no share_code gives it. Takes a sign-in with read-and-change access, and reaches only the lists that account has filed.

update.description: Changes to rows that exist, each by id.

carried_by.description: Who carries it, by the name the list gives that person. Null clears it.

catalog_id.description: Link or relink the row to this catalog row, from search_catalog: it takes the catalog's brand, name, variant, gear type and cited weight, follows catalog corrections, and keeps its folder, place and group. A name, weight_g or gear_type given in the same change is kept as your own. Null unlinks the row, leaving it as it reads.

classification.description: base, worn or consumable; null to follow the folder's default.

folder.description: Move the row to this folder, by name; a new name makes the folder, and an empty string takes it out of every folder. A nested row moved to another folder comes out of its group.

gear_type.description: What kind of thing it is. Null clears it.

group.description: Nest the row under this top-level row, by its id from get_list, in that row's folder; an empty string takes it out of its group, to the top level of its folder. A row with rows under it can't be nested.

kcal.description: Calories per unit, for food. Null clears it.

name.description: A new name. A row keeps a name; it can't be cleared.

note.description: The row's note. Null clears it.

position.description: Where the row goes among its neighbours, 0 for first. Without it a row moved to another folder or group goes last.

variant.description: Size, length or configuration. Null clears it.

volume_l.description: Water only (a name ending in water), in place of qty and weight_g: its whole volume in litres.

weight_g.description: Weight of ONE unit, in grams. Kept as your own figure on a row picked from the catalog.

worn_qty.description: Of qty, how many are worn rather than carried; 0 removes the split.

name: edit_list

folders.description: Every folder's name, in the list's order, after the change.

folders_changed.description: Folders renamed, reordered, reclassified or removed.

folders_made.description: Folders that didn't exist and were made for rows named into them.

removed.description: Rows taken off: by remove, with a removed group, or with a removed folder.

repeated.description: True when this call, with rows to add, repeated one made in the last ten minutes: nothing was done again, and the figures are that call's. Pass again: true to do it a second time.

totals.description: Whole grams, summed over every row of the list.

carried_g.description: base_g plus consumable_g: what is on your back.

kcal.description: Only when a food row carries calories.

unit.description: The unit the list displays in. Weights are in grams regardless.
